name: seed-invariant-search
theory_gate_citation: docs/STATUS.md P1-local is graded 'Proof target needed': the saved alternating-loop alignments are excluded only as finite walks. Whether an inductive invariant could exclude them uniformly is open and is not covered by any row of docs/theory/README.md §4.
notes: Not a search over candidate invariants. For window-based (subshift of finite type) invariants there is a unique best candidate at each width k -- the set of k-windows the seed actually shows -- because any invariant true of the seed must contain it and a larger set excludes less. Testing that one set therefore decides the whole family at that k, which is why this is a characterisation and the counting bound does not apply. Rule 90 is the positive control: its language must come back far below 2^k or a full count for Rule 30 measures the instrument rather than the rule.
